title: OntologyReleaseExportOptions
description: Query options of a sealed ontology release export. Definitions come from the release. Bound asset links are the caller's current authorized operational metadata, so they are opt-in.

includeInverses.description: Write the owl:inverseOf pairs the properties state.

includeBoundAssets.description: Write one link per binding from a concept to the asset it is bound to. Not available for CSV.

shaclGate.description: Refuse to export, with status 422 and the validation report, unless the release validates.
